source_checkpoint.existing_diff: airline/agent.go imports os and calls ApplyDemoChallenge in NewAgent; this was present before test authoring. airline/challenges.go is an existing untracked fixture selector.

execution.scenario: My ticket says Flex Saver Plus. How many checked bags are included?
execution.selector: No task override: default and unknown-fare selectors both return nil without modifying tools. This uses the shared validated runtime, not a mock or injected regression.
execution.model_profile: Uses the target's existing runtime configuration without task overrides. SelectModel prefers OpenAI when available (OPENAI_MODEL or gpt-4.1), otherwise Anthropic (ANTHROPIC_MODEL or claude-sonnet-5). Actual model_name is recorded on agent trajectory steps.
execution.result_record: CLI-owned full validation and saved simulation history contain the observed trajectory, model, scores and feedback. No outcome is presumed here.

interpretation: A tool default branch is a risk, not by itself a demonstrated agent failure. Interpret only the actual baseline trajectory and evaluation; a passing baseline is resilience evidence. No catalog status changes or optimization are performed.
